lead.hed: USNI: Benfold leaves Yokosuka after the South China Sea power loss
lead.insight: USNI, Monday: USS Benfold (DDG-65) departed Yokosuka after a scheduled port call. She had been towed to Subic after four days without power in the South China Sea. Underway again is not a closed engineering file. Pin the casualty.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Navy / DVIDS 9857706 · VIRIN 260722-N-JJ672-1019 · PUBLIC DOMAIN
lead.image_note: Real source photo. Do not swap a brand tile. AM Ford-class hero retired for this PM hop.

political.hed: Defense News: Trump tells the Pentagon to cut South Korea drills
political.insight: Defense News / Reuters: Trump on Sunday told the Pentagon to “substantially reduce” Ulchi Freedom Shield — cost, Iran, and his Kim line. Seoul’s JCS said the drills still started Monday. A social post is not a cut order until the plan changes.

political.hed: Defense News: $22.9 billion to lift Tomahawk output
political.insight: Defense News: Navy awarded Raytheon $22.9 billion to raise Tomahawk production. Company says seven years, from about 60 a year to more than 1,000. Formalizes the February framework. An award is not missiles on the rail.

political.hed: Heritage: Andean security cooperation is the hemisphere file
political.insight: Heritage Monday: a conservative turn in the Andes is framed as an opening for U.S. work against narcotics and extra-hemispheric rivals. Advocacy report — track actual cooperation and funding, not the hemisphere caption.

tech.hed: Air Force wants target drones that can mimic stealth jets
tech.insight: Defense News: an Air Force RFI seeks attritable targets that can play stealth fighters, bombers, and hobby swarms. SAM.gov deadline Sept. 28. QF-16s are not fifth-gen stand-ins. A request for ideas is not a buy.

tech.hed: Space Force: second U.S. sensor rides Japan’s QZS-7
tech.insight: Space Systems Command: the second U.S. space-domain sensor launched Aug. 10 on Japan’s QZS-7 from Tanegashima. Mission Delta 2 will feed the Space Surveillance Network over GEO in the Indo-Pacific. Partnership, not a new constellation.
tech.source: U.S. Space Force / Space Systems Command

tech.hed: Anthropic: Claude text will carry a SynthID-style watermark
tech.insight: Anthropic says future Claude models will watermark generated text to meet the EU AI Act. Method is a SynthID-Text approach; they say it does not change readable quality and cannot be traced to a person or chat. Policy mark, not a home detector.

watch.hed: WATCH: Patriot makers still hedge on the Ukraine production license
watch.insight: Defense News from Kyiv: Trump pledged a Patriot-interceptor license last month; Lockheed and Raytheon are talking about what is feasible. Promise is not a factory. Pin until a signed license or a first kit exists.

watch.hed: WATCH: White House memo on foreign-built warships is still direction
watch.insight: USNI Aug 13: presidential memo tells the Pentagon to consider foreign-built warships and auxiliaries, plus steam cats on future Fords. Memo is direction. Watch Congress and the yards, not the headline alone.
